{{nihongo|'''Taga Shrine (Atami)'''|多賀神社 (熱海市)}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izu Province]].

'''Taga Shrine''' (たがじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in Kamitaga, {{ill|Atami|ar|أتامي (شيزوكا)|arz|اتامى|azb|آتامی، شیزوئوکا|ce|Атами|ceb|Atami (lungsod sa Hapon)|cs|Atami (Šizuoka)|cy|Atami|de|Atami (Shizuoka)|es|Atami|et|Atami|eu|Atami|fa|آتامی، شیزوئوکا|fi|Atami|fr|Atami|gl|Atami|he|אטאמי|hy|Աթամի|id|Atami, Shizuoka|it|Atami|ja|熱海市|ko|아타미시|lt|Atamis|mg|Atami|ms|Atami, Shizuoka|mzn|آتامی، شیزوئوکا|nl|Atami|pl|Atami|pt|Atami|ro|Atami|ru|Атами|sv|Atami|tg|Атами|th|อาตามิ|tl|Atami|tr|Atami|tt|Атами|tum|Atami|uk|Атамі (Сідзуока)|ur|اٹامی|vi|Atami, Shizuoka|war|Atami, Shizuoka|zh|熱海市|zh_classical|熱海市|zh_min_nan|Atami-chhī|zh_yue|熱海|qid=Q653364}}, {{ill|Shizuoka Prefecture|Q131320|qid=Q131320}}.

=== Enshrined deities ===
The current enshrined deities are the following two, the same as at {{ill|Shimotaga Shrine|ja|下多賀神社|qid=Q119929622}} in the Shimotaga district<ref name="kanko">[http://izutaga.jp/menu.php?obj=153&now=1766 Taga town walk] - Taga Tourism Association</ref>.
* {{ill|Izanagi|lt=Izanagi-no-Mikoto|qid=Q813858}}
* {{ill|Izanami|lt=Izanami-no-Mikoto|qid=Q682306}}

=== History ===
Its founding period is unknown. However, because it is identified with the {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}} "Shiranami-no-Minaawa-no-Mikoto Shrine" of the {{ill|Engishiki|Q1342448|qid=Q1342448}}, it is presumed to In the {{ill|keidai|ja|境内|qid=Q11429002}}, an ancient {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=ritual site}} ({{ill|Kamitaga Miyawaki Site|Q109850263|qid=Q109850263}}) has been found, suggesting it had been treated as a sacred place in some form since before the Engi era<ref name="散歩"></ref>.

This shrine also performs the "{{ill|kashima odo|Q11677163|qid=Q11677163}}" dance that traces its origin to {{ill|Kashima Jingū|Q706499|qid=Q706499}}<ref name="散歩"></ref>.

=== Cultural properties ===
*Taga Shrine {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Kashima Odori}} (Atami City designated intangible folk cultural property)<ref name="市">[https://www.city.atami.lg.jp/shisei/toukei/1001292/1001293.html List of cultural properties in Atami] Atami City</ref>

=== Festivals ===
* Grand annual festival (July 28-29)
** July 28 - Eve festival rites, divine procession, Kashima dance, floats and mikoshi<ref>[https://atamii.jp/today/上多賀に祭り囃子-宵宮祭で多賀神社例大祭始まる/ Festival music in Kamitaga: Taga Shrine grand festival begins with eve procession] - Atami Net News, 2019/7/29</ref>.
** July 29 - Main festival rites, divine procession, Kashima dance, hōren beach-descent ceremony (Tomata Port), return procession festival, floats and mikoshi<ref>[https://atamii.jp/today/114418/ Taga Shrine grand festival: magnificent divine procession closes Atami summer festivals] - Atami Net News, 2019/7/30</ref>.

=== Access ===
*10 minutes on foot from {{ill|Izu-Taga Station|Q11380555|qid=Q11380555}}.
